sloka: गृहीत्वा तां गदां भीमामाविध्य च पुनःपुनः।मत्तानीकं महात्मानं जघान रणमूर्धनि ।। ६.७०.५९ ।।
transliteration: gṛhītvā tāṁ gadāṁ bhīmāmāvidhya ca punaḥpunaḥ।mattānīkaṁ mahātmānaṁ jaghāna raṇamūrdhani ।। 6.70.59 ।।

translations.english: The chief of the Vanaras, whose form was like a mountain, endowed with speed, got up quickly, duly, and forcibly hit the Rakshasa (Mahaparsva) in the space between his arms.
